axes: Unity metres, authored in Unity axes (x right, y up, z forward); Blender = (-x, -z, y); the FBX export is the harbour's (-Z forward, Y up, bake_space_transform). Every FBX object sits at the origin with an identity transform: the Unity builder parents it to the item/prefab root. The front of a prop faces +z. Pivot = base centre or the grip (see each entry).

encoding.uv1: Layer = (palette slot, texture layer) per corner; no uv1.z in the FBX; all props use M_Toon_Base
encoding.colour: Col = 0.5 x ao x tint: a per-vertex BVH ray-cast AO bake (40 rays, distance 0.35 x size clamped 0.04-0.45 m, self occlusion plus a ground plane at y = 0 for ground props); fished-up variants multiply by 0.60 (the wet tint)

palette.note: Slots 16-31 are NEW: the Unity palette texture (and the 16 -> 32 wide slot lookup in the shader) must be extended on the PC. Slots 11-15 (harbour preview-only) are not used.
